lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region. A higher density of smaller, stochastically arranged blobs is present in the area immediately dorsal and posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the most prominent ridge shows a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on its dorsal edge and low-intensity shadow pixels on its ventral edge, extending toward the caudal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch or irregular indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin near the apex. A distinct, high-contrast white mark is visible on the mid-anterior surface of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a unique pattern of irregularly spaced, small high-luminance spots that decrease in density toward the distal trailing edge.
